entities.summary: Furuset Church is a church that was consecrated in 1980. The church is located in the neighborhood of Furuset in Oslo, Norway. In the same area was a church in the Middle Ages, from which keys of iron were found, are preserved and placed in the present church. Furuset Church is a church building in Europe, established in 1980. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
